name: Stanley No. 4 Bench Plane
description: The No. 4 smoothing plane is the workhorse of hand-tool woodworking. It flattens, smooths, and trues surfaces to a finish no sandpaper can match — leaving a burnished, light-catching face that brings out the full character of the wood.
alt: Stanley No. 4 bench plane on a wood surface

name: Lie-Nielsen No. 7 Jointer Plane
description: The longest plane in the bench plane family, the No. 7 jointer is used to flatten and true the faces and edges of long boards. Its length bridges low spots and shaves down high ones, making it ideal for preparing glue-up joints.
use: Flattening wide boards, truing long edges for glue-ups

name: Narex 6-Piece Chisel Set
description: A set of six bench chisels in sizes from 6mm to 32mm, made from chrome-manganese steel that takes and holds a sharp edge well. These are a great entry-level set that outperforms many pricier options and can be sharpened to a razor edge.
use: Chopping mortises, paring joints, cleaning up dovetails

name: DeWalt DW735 Thickness Planer
description: A 13-inch, two-speed thickness planer with a 15-amp motor. The three-knife cutter head rotates at 10,000 RPM and produces a smooth, consistent surface across the full width of the board. Fan-assisted chip ejection keeps the work area clean.
use: Surfacing rough lumber, reducing board thickness

name: Festool Domino DF 500
description: The Domino joiner cuts a mortise and injects a loose tenon in one step, making it one of the fastest and most accurate joinery tools available. Perfect for face frames, door rails, and table aprons where speed and alignment matter.
use: Loose tenon joinery, face frame assembly, panel alignment

name: Veritas Marking Gauge
description: A wheel-style marking gauge with a micro-adjust knob that allows precise setting to within a fraction of a millimeter. The cutter scores cleanly across and with the grain, leaving a crisp reference line that guides saw cuts and chisels.
use: Marking tenon shoulders, dovetail baselines, mortise depths

name: Woodcraft 12-inch Combination Square
description: A precision ground 12-inch combination square with a hardened stainless steel blade and cast iron head. Used to check square and 45-degree angles, mark lines parallel to an edge, and set cutting depths. An indispensable layout tool.
use: Checking square, marking parallel lines, depth setting

name: Mirka DEROS 5-inch Sander
description: A brushless, battery-free electric random orbit sander known for its incredibly smooth action and near-silent operation. The DEROS leaves virtually no swirl marks and is gentle enough for final sanding before finishing. Pairs with Mirka Abranet abrasive mesh for superior dust extraction.
use: Surface preparation, final sanding before stain or finish
